checklist.requirement: Declare metric signature and coordinate convention.
checklist.acceptance_test: Every derivative, metric contraction, and c factor has a declared SI interpretation.
The scalar kinetic and potential signs are tied to the selected signature and positive-energy convention.

checklist.requirement: Declare V(Psi) or explicitly hold it symbolic.
checklist.acceptance_test: If V(Psi) is symbolic, no dV/dPsi closure claim is allowed.

checklist.requirement: Vary S_Psi with respect to Psi.
checklist.acceptance_test: Boundary terms are recorded; sign of Box Psi and sign of dV/dPsi are checked.

checklist.requirement: Vary S_Psi with respect to g^{mu nu}.
checklist.acceptance_test: T_Psi_mu_nu is derived from metric variation, not imported by memory.
Kinetic density, potential density, stress-energy, action, and coupling constants all resolve to declared dimensions.
Psi off, derivative off, and coupling off recover the declared null target.
GR and any declared Lambda-CDM baseline are recovered within explicit assumptions.
Either nabla_mu T_total^{mu nu}=0 with separate matter conservation, or an explicit exchange current Q^nu is declared.
Any scalar-matter coupling is compared to fifth-force/equivalence routes before safety language is allowed.
